project_info.theme: Sunny summer combo sale staged on a striped beach chair
project_info.color_palette: Sunshine Yellow, Sand Beige, Orange Towel, Forest Green, Plum Purple, White

main_subject.detail: A summer lifestyle product arrangement on a yellow-blue-white striped folding beach chair featuring multiple Cocoon products, with a large yellow badge reading 'COMBO 2 GIẢM ĐẾN 41%' and a bold bottom headline 'TÓC SẠCH KHỎE DA RẠNG NGỜI'.
main_subject.style: Styled commercial product photography, bright seasonal merchandising, beach-inspired summer visual

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'COMBO 2 GIẢM ĐẾN 41%' and 'TÓC SẠCH KHỎE DA RẠNG NGỜI'. Product labels remain visible on the featured Cocoon bottles and tube.
items: Top Left: Large round yellow discount badge with red text 'COMBO 2 GIẢM ĐẾN 41%'.
Top Right: Upper section of a striped folding beach chair with a tall green pomelo shampoo bottle standing upright and an amber winter melon bottle leaning diagonally.
Bottom Left: Orange-and-white towel draped across the chair, small green bottle lying horizontally, dark body polish jar near the lower edge, and a wooden crate filled with cucumbers.
Bottom Right: White chair frame cutting diagonally across the composition, creating strong geometric lines.
Center/Background: Purple tube centered on the chair seat, warm sandy backdrop, bright hard sunlight, and giant yellow headline text stacked across the bottom.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm highlights, crisp directional shadows, vivid seasonal color contrast, beach-day energy

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity styled commercial product photography

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a sunny summer combo sale staged on a striped beach chair. Centerpiece is a bright arrangement of Cocoon products on a yellow-blue-white folding chair, including a green pomelo shampoo bottle, an amber winter melon bottle, a purple scrub tube, a small green bottle, and a dark body polish jar. Background is a warm sandy setting with an orange striped towel and a crate of cucumbers. Surrounding elements: a large yellow badge reading 'COMBO 2 GIẢM ĐẾN 41%' in the upper left and huge stacked yellow text 'TÓC SẠCH KHỎE DA RẠNG NGỜI' across the bottom. Keep the diagonal chair framing, strong sunlight, and summery merchandising mood. Technical style: high fidelity styled commercial product photography, bright summer sunlight, warm highlights and crisp directional shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
